close_reason: Defined pub(crate) const PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID = 'placeholder-blob' in helpers.rs. Updated email.rs blob_id assignment and debug_assert to use the constant. Test file uses the literal with a comment referencing PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID.
description: The string literal 'placeholder-blob' appears in email.rs (line 1465), in the debug_assert in handle_email_set (line 949), and as a condition in MemoryBackend::create_object. This is a stringly-typed contract: if any one of the three sites uses a different string, the contract silently breaks. The string is not defined as a constant. Suggested: define pub(crate) const PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID: &str = 'placeholder-blob'; and reference it everywhere. This makes the contract visible and grep-able.
title: placeholder-blob sentinel value is a stringly-typed contract between email.rs and MailBackend
